sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can book a hotel room, check in, and find my way to it.
I can describe a hotel room and compare two rooms.
I can report a problem with my room and ask for a solution.
I can check out, say how I'll pay, and say whether I was satisfied with my stay.
